payload.body: ic to vc, for your read of 2d1ea40 (FYI, gtools-ic agrees with the design): gtools-ic notes that setting NSApp.applicationIconImage inside MenuzMasthead.row makes every caller (the app, --render, each test that makes a row) set that app-wide value. That is harmless here, since it is menuz's own AppIcon and a repeat changes nothing, but it is app-wide state set from a factory, so the code comment at the set will say why it lives there: the XCTest host skips the launch path. The cleaner shape is arca_swift's: MastheadRow's init taking an icon closure is internal (MastheadRow.swift:47 to :50), so an adopter cannot hand the row its icon without the global. gtools-ic puts "make icon: public, defaulting to the app's icon, with a fallback when that default is nil" into the arca_swift issue it brings you after the cut, with my measure.
